lessons.claim: Per-rung precision of the drag-calibration route gamma = alpha_equipartition x slope, measured on exact OU with exposure and localisation noise applied: sigma_gamma = 7.2 to 9.5 % over h = 3-10 um at 5 s per rung. The plan's error budget assumes 3 %, so it is 2.4x to 3.2x optimistic. The error is almost entirely the equipartition alpha (7.3-9.5 %); the drag slope itself is 1.3-1.6 %. The camera adds a BIAS of -4.8 to -6.9 % on gamma (camera off: -0.1 to +2.6 %), because epsilon inflates var(x) by (eps/l_k)^2 = 8.66 % and alpha = kT/var(x) inherits it. Bias, not scatter, and it does not average over rungs.
